The Par-Tee.

The experience

A celebration with personality.

The celebration reimagined the milestone of turning thirty through a golf-inspired “Par-Tee” theme. A pink golf cart, a custom welcome sign, and a cluster of pink, sage, and ivory balloons established the tone from the moment guests arrived.

As the event moved into evening, illuminated “30” numbers, softly lit pool water, and a dramatic fire feature transformed the outdoor setting. Coordinated guest favor bags and smaller decorative touches gave the celebration a consistent visual identity. Live dance, fire, and acrobatic performances added another dimension to the guest experience.

01 / The arrival

A playful welcome.

A pastel balloon installation framed the pink golf cart and a custom “Welcome to the Par-Tee” display.

02 / After dark

The evening glow.

Oversized illuminated numbers, balloon accents, pool lighting, and the fire feature defined the nighttime setting.

03 / Small touches

Details for guests.

A coordinated display of patterned favor bags carried the celebration’s polished presentation into the smaller moments.

Beyond the décor / Live entertainment

The night came alive.

Live performers brought energy and spectacle to the celebration. A candlelit dance and fire artistry gave guests a memorable live entertainment experience beyond the décor.
